# @nest-native/cache

> 标签: cache, cache-invalidation, drizzle, listen-notify, nestjs, no-redis, postgres, tags, typescript

## 简介

NestJS adapter for @stalefree/core — tag-based cache invalidation through the database you already have; no Redis
